newsitem.title: USA: Young Fla. mother with HIV accused of biting son.
newsitem.headline: Young Fla. mother with HIV accused of biting son.

text.p: An 18-year-old Florida woman will be tried on charges of attempted murder next week in the alleged biting of her infant son to give him HIV, the virus that causes AIDS, court officials said Tuesday.
Trial for Hasina Zangronis was set for May 28.
She was arrested on April 12 and charged with child abuse, said a spokesman for the Homestead Police Department.
However, the state attorney's office later upgraded the charge to aggravated child abuse and attempted second-degree murder.
According to court documents, Zangronis pleaded innocent to causing the eight adult bitemarks police said were found on the 2-month-old.

The baby, who was not named, was in the custody of his grandparents. Initial tests showed the virus had not been passed to the little boy. However, doctors said it could be months or years before the virus was detectable.
